lines.en: label makidate1:
Maybe I’ll give Makoto’s mother a call?
lines.zh: 要不我给 Makoto 的妈妈打个电话？

lines.en: Under most pretenses, I probably wouldn’t make my first call to someone I barely know just before nightfall, but she tends to work late anyway so maybe she’s used to it?
lines.zh: 换作别的情况，我大概不会在天快黑的时候，第一次给一个几乎不认识的人打电话。不过她反正也常常工作到很晚，所以也许她已经习惯了？

lines.en: Besides, Makoto is pretty much always at the shop anyway and this might give me a good opportunity to be alone with her.
lines.zh: 再说，Makoto 反正基本都在店里，这说不定能给我一个和她独处的好机会。

lines.en: I tap on Maki’s name in my phone and listen to it ring a few times, hoping she picks up.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Maki 的名字，听着铃声响了几遍，希望她会接。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey, Maki? This is your daughter’s teacher.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Maki？我是你女儿的老师。

lines.en: : Oh, hey!
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨！

lines.en: : Normally, people introduce themselves by their name and not their job over the phone.
lines.zh: : 一般来说，人们在电话里自我介绍时报的是名字，不是职业。

lines.en: Normally, people {i}know{/i} their name to begin with.
lines.zh: : 一般来说，人总得先{i}知道{/i}自己的名字吧。

lines.en: : Sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : No need to apologize. I just don't know what to call you.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。我只是不知道该怎么称呼你。

lines.en: : Just Sensei is fine.
lines.zh: : 就叫我 Sensei 好了。

lines.en: : Hmm...Okay, okay. But if you get to go by your job, I want to as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧好吧。不过既然你可以用职业当名字，那我也要。

lines.en: : You want me to call you...porn salesman?
lines.zh: : 你想让我叫你……卖黄片的？

lines.en: : Beautiful porn salesman preferably, but sure.
lines.zh: : 最好叫「美丽的卖黄片的」，不过随便你。

lines.en: : I’ll see if I can remember that.
lines.zh: : 我尽量记着吧。

lines.en: : So what’s up? Why are you calling so late?
lines.zh: : 那么，什么事？怎么这么晚打来？

lines.en: : Did something happen with Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Nothing in particular. I just wanted to see if you’d like to meet up for coffee or something.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的。我只是想问问你愿不愿意出来喝杯咖啡什么的。

lines.en: : ...Coffee?
: Yeah. It’s that brown stuff tired people drink.
lines.zh: : 对。就是那种累的人会喝的棕色液体。

lines.en: : Sensei, are you asking a married woman out on a date right now?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你现在是在约一个已婚女人出去约会吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Yes, I suppose I am.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想是的。

lines.en: : Hah! Well at least you’re up front about it.
lines.zh: : 哈！行吧，至少你还挺坦荡。

lines.en: : I can probably slip away for a little while if you want to meet up at Koi Cafe.
lines.zh: : 你要是想去 Koi Cafe 碰面，我应该能溜出来一会儿。

lines.en: : Yeah, that works for me. I’ll start heading over now.
lines.zh: : 好，我没问题。我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Same here. I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 我也是。待会儿见。

lines.en: Well...She just seems full of energy.
lines.zh: 嗯……她看起来精力充沛得很。

lines.en: I have to admit, I saw that call ending a little differently once she brought out the “married woman” line.
lines.zh: 我得承认，她搬出「已婚女人」那句的时候，我以为这通电话会以另一种方式收场。

lines.en: But I guess it’s not really my place to question her relationship.
lines.zh: 不过我想，她的婚姻状况也轮不到我来质疑。

lines.en: I’ll just head over to the cafe and wait for her to get there.
lines.zh: 我就去咖啡厅等她好了。

lines.en: scene black
scene mollycafe1
: Welcome to Good Burger, home of the Good Burger. Can I take your order?
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Good Burger，Good Burger 之家。可以点单了吗？

lines.en: : ...What?
: It’s a thing. Don’t ask questions.
lines.zh: : 这是个梗。别问。

lines.en: : Sure, Molly.
lines.zh: : 行吧，Molly。

lines.en: : Can I just get a black coffee? I’m meeting someone here in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 给我一杯黑咖啡就行。我过几分钟要在这儿见个人。

lines.en: scene mollycafe18
: Meeting someone? Like...on a date thingy?
lines.zh: : 见人？像是……约会那种？

lines.en: : Uhh, I guess so.
lines.zh: : 呃，算是吧。

lines.en: : It’s just Makoto’s mom.
lines.zh: : 只是 Makoto 的妈妈而已。

lines.en: : Makoto? Like, glasses Makoto? The Witch of the West Wind?
lines.zh: : Makoto？就是那个戴眼镜的 Makoto？西风女巫？

lines.en: : You gave her a nickname too?...
lines.zh: : 你也给她起外号了？……

lines.en: scene mollycafe1
: Of course! And I’ll do my best to not disrupt your date thingy!
lines.zh: : 当然！而且我一定会尽力不打扰你们的约会哦！

lines.en: : As a fellow degenerate, I know just how hard it can be finding love in this day and age. I’m cheering for you, Sir!
lines.zh: : 作为一个同好的变态，我太清楚这年头找真爱有多难了。我为你加油，先生！

lines.en: : Really? I kind of saw this going a little differently.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我还以为会发展成别的样子呢。

lines.en: : No, no! Not at all! Go sit down in the corner! I’ll even bring over something special once she gets here.
lines.zh: : 不不不！绝对不会！你去角落里坐下吧！等她来了，我还会给你们送点特别的东西过去。

lines.en: : That’s really considerate of you, Molly. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 你真体贴，Molly。谢了。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate1
I take a seat near the back wall and wait for Maki to arrive.
lines.zh: 我在靠后墙的位置坐下，等 Maki 过来。

lines.en: I wonder what sort of “special” thing Molly is going to bring over once the time comes?
lines.zh: 我在想，到时候 Molly 会送点什么样的「特别」东西过来？

lines.en: I hope it’s not anything explosive.
lines.zh: 希望不是什么会爆炸的东西。

lines.en: scene black
scene makifirstdate2
: Hey. Sorry it took me so long. Makoto had a question about blowjobs that I needed to answer.
lines.zh: : 嘿。抱歉来晚了。Makoto 问了个关于口交的问题，我得先给她解答。

lines.en: : That’s probably the strangest intro to a date I’ve ever had the pleasure of hearing.
lines.zh: : 这大概是我有幸听到过的最奇怪的约会开场白了。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate3
: Such is the life of the newly proclaimed “Beautiful Porn Salesman.”
lines.zh: : 这就是新晋「美丽的卖黄片的」的生活啊。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot that was your nickname now.
lines.zh: : 哦对。我都忘了那现在是你的外号了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. So did I until five seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我五秒钟前也忘了。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate4
: Which is also right around the time that I became acutely aware that I’m still wearing my tracksuit.
lines.zh: : 大概也就是在那个时候，我异常清楚地意识到自己还穿着运动服。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate3
: You don’t mind, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不介意吧？

lines.en: : Not at all. If anything, I think it even accentuates your beauty.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。要说的话，我觉得它反而更衬你的美。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate5
: Yeah, they {i}do{/i} look pretty nice in this, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 是啊，穿这个看着{i}确实{/i}挺不错的，对吧？

lines.en: : Most people beat around the bush when they say that, though.
lines.zh: : 不过大多数人这么说的时候都会拐弯抹角。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate6
: Heh. Bush.
lines.zh: : 嘿。灌木丛。

lines.en: Is Makoto really related to this woman?
lines.zh: Makoto 真的和这个女人有血缘关系吗？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate2
: But anyway, thanks for calling me and blah blah blah. It’s not often I get out anymore, which I’m sure you’re able to tell by the get-up.
lines.zh: : 总之，谢谢你叫我出来，吧啦吧啦。我现在很少出门了——看我这身行头你应该也看得出来。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate7
: Oh how I have longed for the days to go out and enjoy my youth once again.
lines.zh: : 我多怀念那些能出门、再享受一次青春的日子啊。

lines.en: : The life of a parent is truly a rough one.
lines.zh: : 为人父母的日子真是艰难。

lines.en: : I can imagine. Makoto’s a good girl, though. At least she makes it easy on you.
lines.zh: : 我能想象。不过 Makoto 是个好孩子。至少她让你省心。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate3
: She does now. But she was miserable as a kid. It was always “I want this. I want that. Buy me an encyclopedia.”
lines.zh: : 现在确实省心。可她小时候可难伺候了。永远是「我要这个。我要那个。给我买套百科全书。」

lines.en: scene makifirstdate7
: I mean, really? What kind of five year old wants an encyclopedia for their birthday? Ask for a pony or something. Jeez.
lines.zh: : 我是说，真的假的？哪个五岁小孩生日会想要百科全书啊？要匹小马什么的不好吗。天哪。

lines.en: : Wow. She was like that back then, too?
lines.zh: : 哇。她那时候就这样了？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate2
: Oh yeah. Big time. But hey, at least she’s consistent. Right?
lines.zh: : 哦是啊。非常。不过话说回来，至少她一直没变，对吧？

lines.en: : And she’s smarter than both her father and me now, so I can’t help but be proud of her.
lines.zh: : 而且她现在比她爸和我都聪明，所以我忍不住为她骄傲。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate3
: High maintenance or not, she’ll always be my little girl.
lines.zh: : 不管难不难伺候，她永远是我的小姑娘。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate8
Molly shows up at the table and places a normal cup of coffee in front of Maki.
lines.zh: Molly 走到桌边，把一杯普普通通的咖啡放到 Maki 面前。

lines.en: How is this, in any way, special?
lines.zh: 这到底哪里「特别」了？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate9
: That’s strange. I just felt the atmosphere in here change a little.
lines.zh: : 好奇怪。我刚才感觉这里的气氛变了一下。

lines.en: : It feels...darker in some way.
lines.zh: : 感觉……在某种程度上变暗了。

lines.en: : Well, that’s...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那是……

lines.en: : Someone is giving me the death-stare, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 有人在瞪我，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think that might be my fault.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得那可能是我的错。

lines.en: : Clíodhna, beseech unto me a fraction of your beauty so that I may leave this harlot in the grimy waters of Glandore to {i}drown{/i}.
lines.zh: : Clíodhna 啊，求你分我一丝你的美丽，好让我把这个荡妇留在 Glandore 的污水里{i}淹死{/i}。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate10
: Uhh, hello there.
lines.zh: : 呃，你好啊。

lines.en: : Molly, please tell me that the coffee you brought to the table isn't poisoned.
lines.zh: : Molly，请你告诉我，你端上桌的这杯咖啡没下毒。

lines.en: : What do you think you're doing here?
lines.zh: : 你以为你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Umm...Have I done something to offend you?
lines.zh: : 呃……我做了什么冒犯你的事吗？

lines.en: : State your name and occupation, harlot.
lines.zh: : 报上你的名字和职业，荡妇。

lines.en: : Maki Miyamura. Beautiful porn salesman.
lines.zh: : Maki Miyamura。美丽的卖黄片的。

lines.en: : And what exactly is it you intend to do with my master, {i}Maki Miyamura{/i}?
lines.zh: : 那你到底打算拿我的主人怎样，{i}Maki Miyamura{/i}？

lines.en: : Master?...
scene makifirstdate11
: Isn’t she a little young?...
lines.zh: : 她是不是有点太小了？……

lines.en: : Not that kind of master, Maki...
lines.zh: : 不是那种主人，Maki……

lines.en: Though, I wouldn’t exactly complain if that were the case...
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，要是真是那种，我也不会抱怨就是了……

lines.en: scene makifirstdate12
: The two of us were just having some coffee. It’s an entirely wholesome meeting and you’re welcome to join us if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 我们俩只是在喝咖啡。这完全是场清清白白的会面，你想加入的话随时欢迎。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I can not. Your aura is suffocating me.
lines.zh: : 恐怕不行。你的气场让我窒息。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate11
: {i}I think this girl might like you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得这姑娘可能喜欢你。{/i}

lines.en: : I don’t think she’s into actual humans, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不觉得她对真正的人类有兴趣。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate13
: Ahh...A hentai fan then?
lines.zh: : 啊……那就是个变态动画迷？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate14
: L-Leave my fetishes out of this, devil-woman!
lines.zh: : 别、别把我的癖好扯进来，恶魔女！

lines.en: : Tell me, child, what kind of hentai are you into? Vanilla? Tentacles? {i}NTR?{/i}
lines.zh: : 告诉我，孩子，你喜欢哪种变态动画？普通向？触手？{i}NTR？{/i}

lines.en: scene makifirstdate15
: I hate NTR! Don’t even get me started!
lines.zh: : 我最恨 NTR！别提了！

lines.en: : Hmmm...I see, I see. So you approached this table because you’re afraid that I’m going to get to your {i}master{/i} before you. Is that it?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我明白了，我明白了。所以你凑到这张桌子来，是因为怕我先一步得手你的{i}主人{/i}。是这样吧？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate16
: You have horrible taste in women, Sir.
lines.zh: : 先生，你的女人品味真糟糕。

lines.en: : This is clearly a succubus and you’ve just been lured into her trap.
lines.zh: : 这明显是个魅魔，而你已经被她诱进陷阱里了。

lines.en: : It is the only possible explanation.
lines.zh: : 这是唯一可能的解释。

lines.en: : But do not fear. I shall protect you.
lines.zh: : 但不要怕。我会保护你的。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate17
: Though...I suppose I wouldn’t mind sharing him with you as long as he’s okay with it.
lines.zh: : 不过……我想只要他没意见，我也不介意和你分享他。

lines.en: : Definitely okay with it.
lines.zh: : 完全没意见。

lines.en: : Sh...Sharing...him?
lines.zh: : 分……分享……他？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate18
: Of course, my dear. Real succubi like myself can thrive off the energy of both males and females alike.
lines.zh: : 当然了，亲爱的。像我这样真正的魅魔，无论男女的能量都能汲取。

lines.en: : Would you like me to show you how?...
lines.zh: : 要我给你示范一下吗？……

lines.en: scene makifirstdate19
: A threesome with Master and a succubus?...
lines.zh: : 和主人、还有魅魔玩三人性爱？……

lines.en: : Perhaps...something like this would strengthen our bond?...
lines.zh: : 也许……这样的事能让我们之间的羁绊更深？……

lines.en: scene makifirstdate18
: Will you leave us enough life essence to live our lives normally afterward? Or do you plan on taking everything?
lines.zh: : 你会给我们留下足够的生命精华、让我们之后还能正常生活吗？还是说你打算全部吸走？

lines.en: : {i}Everything.{/i}
: But I’ll make it worth your while. I promise.
lines.zh: : 不过我会让你觉得值得的。我保证。

lines.en: : Maki, it’s probably not healthy to go along with this. Molly tends to believe pretty much anything she-
lines.zh: : Maki，跟着她一起闹大概不太健康。Molly 基本上什么都信——

lines.en: scene makifirstdate20
: I’ll do it!
lines.zh: : 我要做！

lines.en: : I-I don’t know much about pleasing women...But I have played several yuri games and I’m sure I could figure it out!
lines.zh: : 我、我不太懂怎么取悦女人……但我玩过好几部百合游戏，我肯定能搞明白的！

lines.en: : Leave the ‘pleasing’ to me, dear. You just sit back and relax...
lines.zh: : 「取悦」的事就交给我吧，亲爱的。你就坐着放松就好……

lines.en: scene makifirstdate21
: AAAAHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : I’LL BE RIGHT BACK!
lines.zh: : 我马上回来！

lines.en: scene makifirstdate22
Molly quickly sprints into the back room and I can hear a few things being knocked over in the process.
lines.zh: Molly 飞快地冲进后间，我听见一路上有什么东西被撞翻了。

lines.en: The poor girl is probably having a heart attack as we speak.
lines.zh: 这可怜的姑娘这会儿大概心脏病都要犯了。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate23
: You’re kind of terrifying.
lines.zh: : 你有点吓人。

lines.en: : Yeah. I kind of am.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我是有点。

lines.en: : Years and years of experience. I’m pretty good at figuring out what will set people off.
lines.zh: : 多年的经验。我很擅长判断什么东西能把人点着。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate25
: I’m sure you know I don’t really plan on having a threesome with you two, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过我相信你知道，我其实并不打算和你俩玩三人行。对吧？

lines.en: Damnit.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Sorry, Sensei. I don’t think my daughter would be very happy with me if I did that kind of stuff with one of her classmates.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～抱歉啦，Sensei。要是我和她同学做那种事，我女儿大概会很不高兴的。

lines.en: : Her {i}teacher{/i} on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 不过她{i}老师{/i}的话就另当别论了……

lines.en: Woah. Am I already in the clear?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。我这就过关了？

lines.en: Was that husband thing from earlier just a bluff?
lines.zh: : 刚才那句「丈夫」其实是在唬我？

lines.en: : Not like it matters to me but...aren’t you married?
lines.zh: : 我也不是在意，不过……你不是结婚了吗？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate23
: I am. But it’s one of those “open relationship” deals.
lines.zh: : 结了。不过是那种「开放式关系」。

lines.en: : I’m sure my husband is out there in space impregnating an alien-girl as we speak.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，我丈夫这会儿正在外太空把某个外星女孩搞大肚子呢。

lines.en: : Is that even possible?
lines.zh: : 那有可能吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But he’s a smart man. I’m sure he’ll find a way.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。但他是个聪明人。我肯定他能想出办法。

lines.en: : I hear the economy is pretty horrible in space, too. Child support will probably only be a few dollars a month.
lines.zh: : 我听说太空的经济状况也挺糟的。抚养费大概一个月也就几块钱吧。

lines.en: : What is this conversation turning into?
lines.zh: : 这段对话到底在往哪儿发展？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate25
: Hey, {i}you’re{/i} the one who brought up my marriage. I’m just trying to explain the situation to you.
lines.zh: : 嘿，{i}是你{/i}先提起我婚姻的。我只是想跟你解释一下情况。

lines.en: : Does Makoto know about the situation?
lines.zh: : Makoto 知道这个情况吗？

lines.en: scene makifirstdate24
: She...prefers not talking about things like that.
lines.zh: : 她……不太喜欢聊这种事。

lines.en: : And besides, even though it’s an open relationship, it’s not like I’m passing myself around.
lines.zh: : 再说，虽然是开放式关系，我也不至于把自己到处送人。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate25
: Believe it or not, I don’t really have many friends and-
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，我真没什么朋友，而且——

lines.en: : Yeah, I believe that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我信。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate26
: Wait, what? Why did you believe that so easily?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？你为什么这么轻易就信了？

lines.en: : Just the vibe you give off.
lines.zh: : 就是你给人的那种感觉。

lines.en: : It’s like a mix between shut-in, mega-deviant, and doting mother. It’s a strange combination and I can’t imagine it makes it easy to meet people or retain friendships.
lines.zh: : 像是家里蹲、超级变态、和宠溺孩子的母亲混在一起。这组合挺怪的，我想它应该不太利于你认识新朋友、或者维持友情。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate27
: Yup. Pretty much hit the nail on the head with that one.
lines.zh: : 嗯。基本上一针见血。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate28
: It’s fine, though. If sexual feelings happen, they happen. I’m just not the type to go out and actively search for them with anyone.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。要是有了那方面的感觉，那就有了。我只是不是那种会主动跑出去跟谁找感觉的人。

lines.en: : Despite working in a porn shop, I could pretty much live without sex if I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 尽管在色情用品店工作，只要我想，我基本可以过着没有性的生活。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate25
: Obviously doesn’t mean I don’t enjoy it, though.
lines.zh: : 当然这不代表我不享受就是了。

lines.en: : Well that’s...good news?
lines.zh: : 那还真是……好消息？

lines.en: I’m not really sure how to respond to Maki right now.
lines.zh: 我真不知道这会儿该怎么回应 Maki。

lines.en: This conversation is walking a fine line between serious and flirty, and it’s sort of putting me on the back foot.
lines.zh: 这段对话正走在认真与调情之间的细线上，让我有点招架不住。

lines.en: But it’s not like I have a time limit or anything.
lines.zh: 不过我又没有时间限制什么的。

lines.en: I’m sure if the two of us just keep hanging out like this, things are bound to happen eventually.
lines.zh: 我相信，只要我俩就这么一直混在一起，事情迟早会发生的。

lines.en: I just need to make sure Makoto doesn’t find out about it.
lines.zh: 我只需要确保 Makoto 不会发现就好。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate28
: So, do you think the red-haired girl is doing okay?
lines.zh: : 那么，你觉得那个红头发的姑娘还好吗？

lines.en: : She’s been in the back for a while now.
lines.zh: : 她在后面待了好一会儿了。

lines.en: : Molly? I’m sure she’s fine. Just a little worked up.
lines.zh: : Molly？我肯定她没事。只是有点激动过头。

lines.en: scene makifirstdate25
: Sure you don’t want to go check on her?
lines.zh: : 你真不想去看看她？

lines.en: : There are several reasons that I don’t think that would be a good idea right now.
lines.zh: : 有好几个理由让我觉得现在去不是个好主意。

lines.en: : Let’s just finish drinking our coffee and head out.
lines.zh: : 我们喝完咖啡就走吧。

lines.en: : Hahah~ If that’s what you want, sure.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈～你想这样那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene black
And then, the two of us do just that.
lines.zh: 然后，我俩就这么做了。

lines.en: We sit there like civilized adults, sipping coffee and talking about our respective outlooks and interests.
lines.zh: 我们像两个文明的成年人那样坐在那儿，啜着咖啡，聊着各自的观点和兴趣。

lines.en: Maki talks much more than I do.
lines.zh: Maki 说得比我多得多。

lines.en: I just relax and take in as much information as she’s willing to give me.
lines.zh: 我只是放松下来，尽量把她愿意说的信息都接收进去。

lines.en: I’m sure it will come in handy eventually...
lines.zh: 我相信总有一天会派上用场……
